description_for_human: Pay in stablecoins, book 2.2M+ hotels and flights, and invest in fractional stocks — all from chat.
description_for_model: FurlPay is an on-chain financial platform. Use it to check stablecoin and account balances, quote and execute cross-chain stablecoin swaps (USDC/USDT/EURC over CCTP V2 + Li.Fi), create USDC payments (0.5% fee, settled on Arbitrum/Base/Polygon), place fractional stock/ETF orders, deposit idle stablecoins into yield (Earn), search and book travel, and screen wallet addresses for AML risk. Money movement always returns sign data or a confirmation the human approves before it settles — never claim a payment or trade has executed until the API confirms it. Amounts are USD unless a token is specified. Prefer the user's spendable FurlPay account balance for payments.
